title: Modern?
text:
Modern?. When I read the description of this and saw the pictures I had something completely different in mind than what came.

This is not what I would classify as modern in any way. This reminds me of a quilt used by grandparents everywhere - with lots and lots of ruffles.

This falls more into the shabby category rather than the chic in our opinion.

In terms of weight it is pretty middle of the road. It’s not too heavy but people looking for a cool bedding set should probably look elsewhere.

The quality is ok. My set had multi loose threads that I had to snip and remove and some of the stitching is sloppy. It’s not terrible quality but definitely not excellent either.

This set is far too frilly and feminine for our tastes.
